K_{nu,(a,b)}(t) = t^{b-nu_2} if l(nu)<=2 and nu_2<=b<=nu_1, else 0 -- the Kostka-Foulkes polynomial for two-part CONTENT is a single monomial. Proved: the tableau is unique, and the LS extraction consumes the rightmost unused 2 of the left block (charge 0) until it is exhausted, then wraps to the right block (charge 1), giving charge = b - nu_2. Verified 410 pairs n<=9, 0 failures.

Q'_(a,b) = sum_{k=0}^{b} w(k) h_{a+k} h_{b-k}, w(0)=1, w(k)=t^{k-1}(t-1); equivalently Q'_(a,b) - t Q'_(a+1,b-1) = h_a h_b - h_{a+1} h_{b-1}. Proved in the Schur basis from lem-two-part-content-monomial plus the telescoping sum_{k<=K} w(k) = t^K. Does NOT use the general raising-operator formula.

The general raising-operator formula Q'_lambda = prod_{i<j} (1-R_ij)/(1-t R_ij) h_lambda. Verified 29 partitions n<=6, 0 failures, but NOT proved here and deliberately NOT used: prop-two-row-h-expansion is proved independently of it so that Theorem C does not depend on it.

Theorem C: for lambda=(a,b), Y^(a,b)_{x,y} = [y=b]+[x=b]+(t-1)t^{b-1} + (t-1)t^{b-y-1}[1<=y<=b-1] + (t-1)t^{b-x-1}[1<=x<=b-1]; equivalently a three-case formula in m=min(x,y). Proved from thm-B plus prop-two-row-h-expansion. Verified 110 checks n<=9, 0 failures; fresh log regenerated this session (the 10-06 run had none).

Theorem D: on the diagonal min(x,y)=b, Y^(a,b)_(a,b) = t^b - t^{b-1} + 1 + [a=b]. For every odd b>=3 this has a real root in (-1,0) (since D_b(-1) = 2(-1)^b+1 = -1 < 0 and D_b(0)=1>0), hence a root that is neither a root of unity nor 0, hence no factorisation into cyclotomic polynomials and monomials. UPGRADES a previously MEASURED null to a proved theorem.

Census of non-cyclotomic irreducible factors over all two-part rho, n<=8. THREE of the four witnesses (t^2-t+2 = D_{2,2}; t^2-2t+2 | D_{3,3}; t^3-t^2+1 = D_{a,3}) occur at TWO-ROW lambda and are explained in closed form by thm-C; only t^3+t^2-1 needs l(lambda)=3. So the brief's guessed reconciliation (null for general lambda, closed form for two-row lambda) is REFUTED: the separator is product-versus-sum alone. A closed form does exist on this slice; a product form does not.

For b even D_b(-1)=3>0 and the sign argument gives nothing. Factorisations computed non-cyclotomic for all 3<=b<=15, but this is computed, not proved. Not needed: one witness family suffices for the obstruction.

Theorem A: Y^lambda_(n) = (-1)^{l-1} t^{n(lambda)-C(l,2)} phi_{l-1}(t). Proof chain complete and unconditional downstream of lem-hook: Murnaghan-Nakayama reduces to the alternating sum of hook Kostka-Foulkes, and the q-binomial theorem at z=t gives sum_j (-1)^j t^{j(j+1)/2} [m,j]_t = phi_m. Verified 66 partitions n<=8, 0 failures. Stays at computed because lem-hook rests on gap-cell-charge.

K_{(n-r,1^r),mu}(t) = t^{n(mu)-C(l,2)+C(l-r,2)} [l-1,r]_t. The tableau indexing by r-subsets S of {2..l} is proved, and the passage from the cell-level charge to the closed form is proved via sum_S t^{sum(s-1)} = t^{C(r+1,2)} [l-1,r]_t. Verified 686 (mu,r) pairs n<=9, 0 failures.

GAP. charge(T_S) = n(mu)-C(l,2)+C(l-r,2)+sum_{s in S}(s-1)-r(r+1)/2 for the hook tableau T_S. Verified on 1469 tableaux, 0 failures. The r=0 case is PROVED (sum_j C(mu'_j,2) = n(mu)). Breaks down for r>=1: I do not control how the LS extraction distributes the column prefix s_r...s_1 across the mu_1 standard subwords, and the two-letter-alphabet argument of lem-two-part-content-monomial does not transfer.

<h_c h_d, P_mu> = 0 unless l(mu)<=2 and mu_2<=d<=mu_1, else 1-t if mu_2<d<mu_1 and 1 at the ends.
